ModMetaData.name: Body Modder Chance
ModMetaData.author: D_Witchcraft
ModMetaData.description:
Installing artificial body parts with an efficiency rating above 100% generates a small chance for a colonist to gain the Body Modder trait.
The chance increases with the efficiency rating of the installed part and the number of artificial parts with an efficiency rating above 100% that the colonist already has.
Colonists with the Body Purist trait must first lose Body Purist through a successful roll before they can separately gain Body Modder through a later successful roll.
Please note: Colonists who possess the Body Purist gene and have the associated Body Purist trait cannot lose that trait through this mod.
The base chance to lose Body Purist or gain Body Modder can be increased in the mod settings.
